translation.firstTime: Is this your first time here?
translation.infoInInstagram: To see who doesn't follow you, click the <bold>{{buttonText}}</bold> button.
translation.infoNotInInstagram: Instagram needs to be open in the background for the extension to work.
translation.onboardingStep1: Log in to Instagram in your browser
translation.onboardingStep2: Click the button below to scan your account
translation.onboardingStep3: See who doesn't follow you back and unfollow them
translation.scanningInfo: This can take a little while for large accounts. Please keep this tab open until it finishes.
translation.notConnected: Could not connect to Instagram. Please close the extension, refresh Instagram, and try again.
translation.noUnfollowersMessage: You don't have any friends who are not following you back.
translation.authError: You need to log in to Instagram or you don't have permission. Please log in to Instagram and try again.
translation.rateLimitWarning: Please wait {{seconds}} seconds before unfollowing another account
translation.actionBlocked: Instagram temporarily blocked this action. Please wait a few hours and try again.
translation.accountChanged: Profile has changed. Please refresh the list to see the updated unfollowers.
translation.unfollowAllDescription: This will unfollow {{count}} accounts. You can stop anytime, but it can't be undone.
translation.announcementDescription: Our new game is on the App Store! Challenge your friends and play Rock Paper Scissors online, head to head in real time.
